content.title: How to watch Spurs vs. Nuggets NBA game tonight on Prime: Start time, free live stream
content.text: San Antonio Spurs forward Victor Wembanyama (1) celebrates after scoring against the Detroit Pistons during the second half of an NBA basketball game Monday, Feb. 23, 2026, in Detroit. (AP Photo/Duane Burleson)APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Dustin Hockensmith | dhockensmith@pennlive.comTwo of the world’s best players go toe-to-toe Saturday in Denver, where Nikola Jokic and the Nuggets will host Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs. The game is scheduled to start at 3 p.m. ET (1 p.m. MT) with streaming exclusively on Amazon Prime.How to watch: The Spurs vs. Nuggets matchup will be carried live on Prime Video, which comes with a 30-day free trial for new users.San Antonio Spurs (59-18) at Denver Nuggets (49-28)NBA matchup at a glanceWhen: Saturday, April 4 at 3 p.m. ET (1 p.m. MT) Where: Ball Arena, Denver, Colo.TV channel: N/ALive stream: Amazon Prime exclusive (free trial)The Spurs are 1.5-point betting favorites on the road in this battle between owners of the NBA’s two longest winning streaks. San Antonio enters having won 11 straight games, while the Nuggets have won seven in a row to bring the Western Conference’s No. 3 seed into focus with their 49-28 record. San Antonio currently sits in the No. 2 spot with two games standing between them and the Oklahoma City Thunder with five games left to play for both teams.The Spurs are set to play their final road game of the season after winning their previous eight straight away from home, the past seven of which have been by double digits. The Nuggets are kicking off a four-game home stand that includes an April 10 date with the Thunder in their home finale before hitting the road for San Antonio for the regular-season finale for both teams.The Spurs and Nuggets are set for a 3 p.m. ET start exclusively on Prime Video, which comes with a free trial.
